edge_case_notes.malformed_uuid_agent_role_id: PASS — coversInvoke does string equality; malformed UUID does not match well-formed role id, returns false safely. No crash.
edge_case_notes.empty_body: PASS — validateInvokeBody (production code, probe-verified) throws HttpError 400 for null, empty {}, missing goal, non-UUID target_agent_id.
edge_case_notes.double_command_idempotency: PASS — coversInvoke is deterministic pure function; writeInvokeAuditEvent can be called twice (append-only audit, no unique constraint). Handler itself does not deduplicate; each invocation creates a new audit row. Acceptable for day-1 (spec allows this).
edge_case_notes.expired_grant_scope_mismatch: PASS — expired grant (valid_until < nowMs) correctly rejected by isEffective. Grant scoped to cs does not cover fin — correctly rejected by isNarrowerOrEqual.
edge_case_notes.command_does_not_query_invoke_proposal: PASS — static check confirms exactly 1 INSERT INTO choros.invoke_proposal in invoke.ts, only in /request handler, not in /command handler.
